description:
Cast Flash putting Protean Hulk into play, choosing not to pay.
Sacrifice Hulk, getting Ezuri, Sage of Hours, and 4 0 mana value creatures.
Sage of Hours and the 4 creatures will trigger Ezuri's ability, netting you 5 experience counters.
Move to combat, triggering Ezuri's ability.
Put 5 +1/+1 counters from Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours' ability, removing all 5 counters, giving you an extra turn.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for infinite turns.
